{{Otheruses|Council}}
'''Chief council''' was a position within [[Vor]] society. In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], [[Krini-shen]] held this title and, as such, made an important release in the name of the Vors to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] following the [[Destruction of the Cathedral of Winds|destruction]] of the [[Cathedral of Winds/Legends|Cathedral of Winds]].<ref name="EGTAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>
